**Agentivity Desk** is for the people who use what is built in the Studio, without building anything. They ask a Solution for some work, answer when it asks them something, and find their conversations again. This page shows the Desk as a person who uses it sees it.

## What you need

- A workspace with a sign-in. The Desk comes with the Pro and Business plans: not with Personal, nor with the Community edition.
- At least one Solution published to the Desk. An administrator chooses them in **Administration** › **Desk** › **Published to the Desk**. See [What a Solution is, and how to mark one](/docs/introduction/what-a-solution-is/).
- An account on the workspace, on a seat of the Studio or of the Desk.

## Open the Desk

The Desk is at the address of your workspace. The Studio is under `/studio` at the same address. You sign in once for both.

- From the Studio, the menu of a Solution in **Agents & Workflows** offers **Open in Desk**.
- From a conversation in the Desk, **Open in the Studio** takes a builder to the Studio.

A person on a **Desk seat** only starts the Solutions published to the Desk. They do not build anything and do not open the Studio.

## The home

The home is where you ask for work.

- **The field to ask.** Describe what you need, or type **@** to pick the Solution to ask. You can also dictate, and add an image when you ask an agent.
- **Suggestions.** Requests you can start in one click.
- **Waiting for you.** The questions your Solutions ask you, and the decisions they wait for.
- **Time saved.** The time your teams saved you this week and this year.

The Desk shows only the Solutions published to it, and only those you may see. If none is published for you yet, the home says so: ask the person who builds your teams.

## The side bar

| Item | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Home** | The field to ask, and what is above. |
| **Waiting for you** | Every conversation that waits for your answer. |
| **Cockpits** | The starting page of each department. See [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/). |
| **Groups** | Your own groups of conversations. Make one from the Solutions you choose: their conversations go in by themselves. Or fill it by hand. |
| **Recent** | Your latest conversations. |

Select the title **Cockpits**, **Groups** or **Recent** to fold it, and again to open it. Your browser remembers how you left them. A folded **Cockpits** still shows a dot when something waits for you in a cockpit.

**All conversations** lists every conversation, with a search on the titles and on what was said. **Group by** sorts them by **Solution**, **Cockpit**, **Group**, **Status** or **Date**. Tick several conversations to act on all of them at once.

## Work with a conversation

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Rename** | Gives the conversation a title of your own. |
| **Pin** | Keeps it at the top. **Unpin** puts it back. |
| **Put in a group** | Puts it in one of your groups. |
| **Archive** | Moves it to **Archived**. |
| **Stop** | The conversation is still working, or waits for you. Nothing more is done, and nothing waits for you in it any more. |
| **Close** | The work is over. You can still read it, but you cannot write in it any more. |
| **Delete** | Deletes the conversation and its questions, after you confirm. It leaves every list. This cannot be undone. |

Only the person who started a conversation can delete it.

## Share a conversation

1. In the conversation, select **Share**.
2. Type the e-mail of a colleague of your workspace.
3. Leave the box **They may reply in it too** off to let them read only. Turn it on to let them reply.
4. Select **Share**.

Under **Shared with**, each colleague shows with **Reads** or **Reads and replies**. To stop, select **Stop sharing** beside their name. A colleague leaves a shared conversation when they want, with **Leave this conversation**.

## Each person has their own Desk

- Nobody sees the conversations of another person, except those shared with them.
- Titles, pins, archives and groups are yours. On a shared conversation, each person keeps their own.

## How to know it worked

Ask a Solution from the home. The conversation opens, shows the work as it goes, and appears in **Recent**. When the Solution asks you something, the conversation shows in **Waiting for you**.

## If it does not work

- **The home says no Solution is published for you.** Ask an administrator to publish one in **Administration** › **Desk**, and check that you may see it.
- **A Solution is missing.** It is not published to the Desk, or your rights do not let you see it.
- **You cannot delete a conversation.** Someone else started it. Only they can.
